notes: Customising a bear's fur, eyes, ears and body and then romping around with friends is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and playing as the animal in wild forest puts it on Animal Sim's wilderness-open rather than any settlement shape — there is no housing decision to make. The answers settle the rest: one Alaskan valley crossable in about a minute, so a single continuous surface, and open natural shelters any bear can use rather than a den per player, which is den-shelter without personal property. The valley itself is carried as terrain-relief, which adds tiered elevation to the P0 build with nothing overhanging. Deciding without a user: the space is open-ended with no terminus, since hanging out is stated to be the whole game, and I added a shared gathering spot plus one sightline landmark so a small social map still has somewhere to meet and a way to orient.
